title: Not the Pass
scene: You are not ready for the pass. You know that. A permit will not take it, and alone will not take it, and good enough is not a thing you have yet. The next street is quiet. The speed is low. That is where you get ready. The pass can wait. It has been waiting.
debrief: You are not ready for the pass. The next place is a quiet street. That is the work.

source.teaching_target: Name the next place. Not the pass. A quiet street, low speed. She already knows the goal.
